# DOMPurify 3.3.2

The JavaScript, source map, and `LICENSE` in this directory are unchanged files
from the official `dompurify@3.3.2` npm distribution. This is the same version
and JavaScript content previously loaded by the application templates.

- Upstream release: https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify/releases/tag/3.3.2
- Package metadata: https://registry.npmjs.org/dompurify/3.3.2
- Distribution: https://registry.npmjs.org/dompurify/-/dompurify-3.3.2.tgz
- License: MPL-2.0 OR Apache-2.0; full upstream text is in `LICENSE`.
